facts.fact: Interior minister Velonjara Tiaray Rakotonandrasana says nearly 5 million people were enrolled in phase I of Izaho tokana biometric enrolment, about 15% of the 32.7 million population (computed), with reconciliation against the central base still under way.

MDG.note: Enrolment targets adults over 18; no number at birth stated.
No public register keyed on the ID stated.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Interior and Decentralisation launched phase II of Izaho tokana 2.0 biometric enrolment, targeting over 10 million citizens aged over 18 by July 2027 after about 5 million in phase I, with 1,000 extra kits.
